messages:
Maya CSM: Quick check — Lightbox accepted the trial invite and wants to run a 2-week engagement with 3 product teams starting next Tue. Can we confirm kickoff availability and an enablement owner?
Jamal CS Ops: I can own the kickoff Wed 10am PT (unless they insist on Tue). Need roster + SSO status before I send invites.
Priya SE: I can join for the SDK walkthrough and integration troubleshooting. Will prep a short demo for prefix caching and sample prompts.
Ava Product: Heads up — Lightbox flagged a primary success metric: inference latency under 200ms for their chat flow. We'll need to recommend batching/cache settings and a model variant.
Maya CSM: Great. @Jamal — I have the roster but need to scrub PII. Do you want CSV or ok with a Google Sheet? Also they asked about dedicated capacity options.
Jamal CS Ops: CSV preferred, one row per user: email, role, expected concurrent users. Example: 
```
noah@lightbox.com,product-lead,10
lucy@lightbox.com,frontend-dev,3
sam@lightbox.com,data,2
```
Maya CSM: Uploading now to the shared drive: https://redwood.link/ls-lightbox-onboard (private link).
Priya SE: Thanks — I'll review access. Also flagging a likely friction: Lightbox uses an unusual prompt template with long system messages; may need sequence_length tuning or quantized model.
Ava Product: Can we prepare 2 rollout paths: (A) hosted with batching + cache (fastest), (B) dedicated small pool w/ quantized weights (predictable latency)? We should document cost delta.
deploy-bot: New deployment request created by Jamal CS Ops: #ticket-4589 (Lightbox trial capacity scheduling).
Jamal CS Ops: Timeline proposal: Wed kickoff (enablement + demo), Thu integration pairing session, Fri smoke test against their staging, next Mon start trial traffic. Anyone blocked?
Maya CSM: I need to confirm dates with Lightbox — pinging them now. Also asking for sample transcripts for the eval suite.
Priya SE: For the smoke test I'll need API keys and a test route. Suggest using a low-quota key and route `/v1/lightbox-test`. I'll prepare a Postman collection.
Ava Product: I'll draft a short playbook for the customer: recommended config, SLO checklist, rollback steps, and where to file bugs. Put it in our enablement template.
Maya CSM: Lightbox replied — Tue kickoff is better (they have internal sync Wed). Can we shift Jamal?
Jamal CS Ops: I can do Tue 9am PT instead. Updated ticket and calendar.
Priya SE: Ok for me Tue 9am. I'll reserve 60m for walkthrough + 30m for integration triage follow-up.
Maya CSM: Action items: (1) Jamal send invites + calendar with agenda (2) Priya prepare Postman + SDK demo + short troubleshooting checklist (3) Ava write the two rollout option cost/latency table (4) Maya collect sample transcripts and roster CSV.
Ava Product: I'll have the cost/latency table by EOD today and paste in the thread.
Jamal CS Ops: Sending invites now. Calendar note includes: agenda, prerequisite checklist (SSO, test keys, sample prompts), and meeting link.
Priya SE: One more ask — can engineering provide a small eval dataset from Lightbox (anonymized) so we can run the latency/quality sweep? If not, we'll use our synthetic set and note differences.
Maya CSM: I'll request the anonymized dataset in the follow-up email. If they can't share, we'll run synthetic and log assumptions.
Ava Product: Also flagging renewal risk: if latency >250ms for >10% of sessions during trial, they may deprioritize. Let's set monitoring: 95th/99th pct latency in dashboard and alert if breach.
Jamal CS Ops: I'll wire up a temporary dashboard and a Slack alert channel #lightbox-trial-alerts. Will post link once ready.
deploy-bot: Dashboard created: https://grafana.redwood/lightbox-trial (view-only).
Maya CSM: Perfect. I'll send the pre-kickoff email with expectations and ask for any compliance docs they need for Dedicated options.
Priya SE: Noted. I'll also add a tiny integration checklist snippet they can paste into their deploy runbook.
Maya CSM: Thanks team — moving to prep. Follow-up here after kickoff with notes and next steps. :thumbsup:
